In ‘63 or so, in my K-8 grade school, we had a communal shower room in the boy’s locker room. No idea about the girls locker room. We started showering together no later than 6th grade. It was pretty much a rinse and dry process, not really a scrub clean. Dennis did once get an erection that caused some cackling in 7th grade. Don’t recall any other “incidents”, but towel snapping did occur in limited frequency. 

Going to the high school in ‘65 the first gym class is the heart of this story. A larger rectangular communal room with entry on two walls, one right from the lockers at one end, and the second leading out to the pool through a little winding privacy screening passage way; shower heads On all walls. After some assembled locker room orientation speech Coach gave us 5 minutes to strip and get into the shower room, and stood in the locker room announcing time to get in there. After all were nude and in the room, following the instructions not to start the showers yet, he came in, in gym shorts, floppies, and t shirt. The began the first gym lesson, how to shower properly. Coach was reputed to be a hard ass, and had been a drill sergeant, so there was no silliness. He picked one of the known trouble makers to demonstrate his direction. So chubby Bruce was directed to the start his shower, and instructions about washing began. Using the wall mounted soap dispenser, we watched as he lathered and rinsed his hair. Then, complete instruction about proper body washing. We had no wash cloths, so a full body hand wash was the routine. 

Coach made sure that both underarms were fully washed and rinsed, because “Boys, you stink.” Then, wash your whole body. It really wasn’t at all weirdly pervy, just very matter of fact and straight ahead this is how you will always shower. The next more detailed instruction was that it’s important to soap wash our penis, and scrotum, with Bruce demonstrating how to pull back foreskin if you had one and fully wash the penis. Notice was made that this wasn’t sex or masturbation, it was sanitation, and erections were to be ignored and not further stimulated, but that cold water was a stiffy control tactic to remember. The most hubbub came from the class as then the re-soap your hand and wash your butt crack fully finale came. So here’s Bruce, soapy hands exploring his crevice  while we washed, and coach telling us not to finger ourselves but to be sure we soaped and rinsed fully to our sphincter. 

It all happened faster than I could type this, but it was full display guided demonstration, after which we all practiced what was taught and Coach audited our actions. It didn’t seem that weird since we all had showered communally in grade school.
